escalations.title: proxy-addr IP Spoofing — CVSS 9.1
escalations.description: IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses bypass IP-based access control in Express stacks using proxy-addr. Any IP-restricted route is bypassable from the network.

escalations.title: vitest Arbitrary File Read + RCE via UI Server — CVSS 9.8
escalations.owasp: A02: Cryptographic Failures, A07: Authentication Failures
escalations.description: Direct dependency. Path-traversal reads arbitrary files (env, keys); second vector enables RCE via browser-side API. Affects both Frontend projects.
escalations.remediation: npm update vitest in Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend. Do not expose vitest UI server on network until patched.

escalations.title: protobufjs Remote Code Execution via malformed protobuf — CVSS 9.8
escalations.description: Crafted protobuf message triggers prototype pollution in protobufjs, achieving RCE on the server. Affects gRPC-using services.
escalations.remediation: npm update protobufjs @grpc/grpc-js @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node in affected projects.

p1_findings.title: FR namespace entirely disconnected from Specifications/
p1_findings.description: 77 FRs in Specifications/ use FR-001–FR-069 namespace. All Verifies: comments in Source/ use FR-WF-* and FR-dependency-* from Plans/. Zero namespace overlap. Traceability enforcer never reads Specifications/, always reports PASSED.
p1_findings.impact: Every architecture decision citing a Specification ID is unverifiable. Domain compliance cannot be demonstrated.
p1_findings.recommendation: Align FR namespace across Specifications/ and Source/. Extend traceability enforcer to scan Specifications/.

p1_findings.title: Route handlers bypass service layer (3 of 4 route files, 16+ direct store calls)
p1_findings.description: workflow.ts, workItems.ts, and intake.ts import and call workItemStore directly with 16+ calls. Violates CLAUDE.md non-negotiable: 'No direct DB calls from route handlers — use the service layer.'
p1_findings.impact: Untestable business logic, brittle coupling, violation of architecture contract.
p1_findings.recommendation: Extract services/workItemService.ts and services/intakeService.ts. Routes handle HTTP concerns only.

p2_findings.title: Traceability enforcer blind to Specifications/ — always reports PASSED
p2_findings.description: Enforcer scans only Plans/self-judging-workflow/requirements.md (13 FRs). All 77 Specifications/ FRs are permanently invisible.
p2_findings.recommendation: Extend enforcer to also scan Specifications/ directory.

p2_findings.title: Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md describes a superseded system
p2_findings.description: Spec describes feature requests, bug reports, dev cycles, AI voting, SQLite — a system replaced by the self-judging workflow engine. Never archived or updated.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add '## Status: SUPERSEDED' header or archive to Specifications/archive/.

p2_findings.title: eslint-disable suppressions without justification (2 occurrences)
p2_findings.description: Both suppress react-hooks/exhaustive-deps with no comment explaining why. Both modified in last 14 days.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add comments explaining the suppression, or fix the underlying hook dependency issue.
